reviews.body:
The PR branch is 5 commits behind main, so I applied `gh pr diff` onto main (3cb403051) in a detached worktree. It applied cleanly. I ran the checks below with Python 3.13.3.

The unit conftest stubs `google.genai`, so I also ran a probe against the real SDK. I installed google-genai 3.0.0 into a side directory and used real `types.GenerateContentResponse.model_validate(...)` objects.

Real SDK facts:
- `types.FinishReason` is a `str` enum, and `str(types.FinishReason.MAX_TOKENS)` is `'FinishReason.MAX_TOKENS'`.
- On main, all 20 `FinishReason` members map to `stop`. That includes `MAX_TOKENS`, `SAFETY`, `RECITATION` and `BLOCKLIST`.
- With the PR, `MAX_TOKENS` maps to `length`. `SAFETY`, `RECITATION`, `LANGUAGE`, `BLOCKLIST`, `PROHIBITED_CONTENT`, `SPII` and `IMAGE_SAFETY` map to `content_filter`. The other 12 members still map to `stop`.

Through the real converters (main, then PR):

| path | MAX_TOKENS | RECITATION | STOP |
|---|---|---|---|
| `convert_gemini_response_to_openai` | stop, then length | stop, then content_filter | stop, then stop |
| `convert_gemini_stream_chunk_to_openai` | stop, then length | stop, then content_filter | stop, then stop |
| `convert_gemini_stream_chunk_to_openai_completion` | stop, then length | stop, then content_filter | stop, then stop |
| `convert_gemini_response_to_openai_completion` | stop, then length | stop, then content_filter | stop, then stop |

A chunk with no finish reason still gives `None` in the stream path. Plain strings behave the same as before: `"max_tokens"` and `"MAX_TOKENS"` give `length`, and `"FinishReason.MAX_TOKENS"` gives `stop`.

Tests:
- `tests/unit/providers/inference/vertexai` with the PR applied: 295 passed.
- The PR's new `test_converters_requests.py` against unpatched main source: 2 failed (`MAX_TOKENS-length` and `RECITATION-content_filter`), 293 passed.

The test builds its own `str, Enum` class, because the stub replaces the SDK. My probe shows the real SDK enum behaves the same way, so the test is a fair stand-in.

One note, not a blocker. `IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT` and `IMAGE_RECITATION` still map to `stop` with the PR. They are not in `_GEMINI_CONTENT_FILTER_REASONS`, and this PR does not change that table. It could be a follow-up.

Approving.
